_note: Named college regions for kb/_build_partner_crosswalk.py --region-preset. A region is the set of colleges a partner's students could realistically reach; it drives the workbook's Partner Region and Regional Capacity sheets. Add a preset per engagement rather than passing --region by hand, so the next run for the same partner is reproducible.
_schema: presets: { <slug> : { label, rationale, colleges: [ <exact college name as it appears in MAP data> ] } }. College names MUST match the adopter names in statewide_data.js exactly -- a typo silently yields an empty region rather than an error.

san-joaquin.label: San Joaquin County and adjacent
san-joaquin.rationale: San Joaquin County Office of Education engagement (2026-08-05). San Joaquin Delta is the in-county college; the rest are the Central Valley and Sacramento/East Bay colleges within commuting or online reach.
